tool.name: ParaFEM Sievert's Law BC
tool.description: Convert pressure BCs to concentration BCs using Sievert's Law
tool.command:
python3 '$__tool_directory__/gdps_sievert_bc.py' --mesh_d '$mesh_d'
#if $bc_mode.mode == "nset": --bc_mode nset --nset_file '$bc_mode.nset_file' --upstream_nset '$bc_mode.upstream_nset' --downstream_nset '$bc_mode.downstream_nset' #else: --bc_mode zone --bc_axis '$bc_mode.bc_axis' --upstream_min $bc_mode.upstream_min --upstream_max $bc_mode.upstream_max --downstream_min $bc_mode.downstream_min --downstream_max $bc_mode.downstream_max #end if
#if $material_type.source == "database": --material '$material_type.material' #else: --S0 $material_type.S0 --Es $material_type.Es #end if
#if $temp_mode.mode == "scalar": --temp_mode scalar --temp_scalar $temp_mode.temp_scalar #else: --temp_mode field --temp_field '$temp_mode.temp_field' #end if
#if $pressure_type.type == "static": --upstream_p $pressure_type.upstream_p --downstream_p $pressure_type.downstream_p #else: --pressure_schedule '$pressure_file' --output_bcs '$output_bcs' #end if
--output_fix '$output_fix'

param.name: upstream_min
param.label: Upstream zone start (normalised)
param.help: Fraction of axis range; 0.0 = minimum coordinate.

param.name: downstream_max
param.label: Downstream zone end (normalised)
param.help: Fraction of axis range; 1.0 = maximum coordinate.

param.name: temp_field
param.label: Temperature Field File
param.help: EnSight scalar file or .ini file from Extract IC tool

param.name: pressure_schedule
param.label: Pressure Schedule (JSON)
param.help: JSON array of steps with upstream_p and downstream_p

data.name: output_fix
data.label: Fixed concentrations (.fix)
data.help: Initial fixed concentrations. In scheduled mode, uses first schedule entry.

tool.help:
Converts gas pressure (Pa) at boundaries to molar concentration (mol/m^3) using Sievert's Law:
C = S(T) * sqrt(P)
Where solubility S(T) follows the Arrhenius relation:
S(T) = S0 * exp(-Es / RT)
**Node selection modes:** - Zone: identifies boundary nodes by their normalised coordinate along the permeation axis. Suitable when mesh is generated directly from gdps_meshgen_box. - NSET: reads pre-defined node sets from a .nset file.
**Pressure modes:** - Static: generates a .fix file with fixed concentrations at the boundary nodes. - Scheduled: generates both a .fix (initial conditions from first schedule entry) and a .bcs file for time-varying concentrations used by the transient solver.
